17.title: Playmats
17.body:
To change a playmat image, use the 'NEXT PLAYMAT' button on the very side of the board

To add an image to the available set, open Host-> Scripting menu, choose the "[side] Playmat" tab, and refer to first lines of the script.
Alternatively, contact the author about what you would like to add.

The 'CHANGE MAT TYPE' button allows you to have clear rectangle mat but at the expense of plastic click sound on colision with it.
This is how built-in TTS object types (custom board and custom tile) work, can't change their properties.

13.title: Movement
13.body:
Everything you need to know about this mod is avialble at its wiki page(s):

https://github.com/tjakubo2/TTS_xwing/wiki

This below is a quick rundown:

Any models that are loaded into the map will have the script running.

To use "commands" there are 3 simple steps:
1. Right click the model you intend to move
2. Under ship name, there will be an empty text box (dim "Description" label visible), enter your command there
3. Click anywhere on the map (closing the context menu)

Boom! Your ship will automatically move.

If your ship model is not standard (didn't came from the Collection  or Squad Builder), to make it move like a large base ship you have to add 'LGS' anywhere in its name.

Move List (# = speed of the move: 1-5)
examples
3 bank left = bl3 (or be3)
2 turn right = tr2

s# = straight # 
k# = koiogran turn #
br# = bank right #
tr# = turn right #
bl# = bank left #
tl# = turn left #

Alternative left moves:
be# = bank left #
te# = turn left #

bl#s = Segnor's loop left #
br#s = Segnor's loop right #

tl#t = Talon roll left #
tr#t = Talon roll right #

tl#z = Slip turn left #
tr#z = Slip turn right #

bl#z = Slip bank left #
br#z = Slip bank right #

bl#r  = Reverse bank left #
br#r = Reverse bank right #
s#r = Reverse #

rl2 = Barrel Roll left
rr2 = Barrel Roll right
rl1 = Barrel Roll left forward
rr1 = Barrel Roll right forward
rl3 = Barrel Roll left back
rr3 = Barrel Roll right back

cs = decloak straight
cl1 = decloak left forward
cl2 = decloak left
cl3 = decloak left back
cr1 = decloak right forward
cr2 = decloak right
cr3 = decloak right back

Echo decloaking available with the decloack token (drop the token on the ship and the appropriate buttons will appear

r = range/arc ruler 

r (on a bomb token) = range 1 template

q/undo = Undo the ship position to last saved one. Positions are automatically saved before/after a move and can be saved manually (refer to 'keep')

z/redo = Redo ship position if you undid ('q/undo') accidentally

keep = Save a ship's location.  After using the keep command you can pick up and move the ship around then use 'q' to return the ship to the saved location.

For more advanced commands, check:
https://github.com/tjakubo2/TTS_xwing/wiki/Doc%3A-Commands

Note: Ships automatically lock after auto movement.  You can right click on the ship to manually enter moves (ie barrel roll after movement).  You can also unlock the ship to move it for any reason.

AUTO DIALS GUIDE:
Place your ship models in your hiden zone and click "Assign Dials". If you have more than 6, right click the adjacent zone with zone tool (F4) and change it to your color, then use the button next to it.

24.title: New rulers
24.body:
AS OF 1.1.12

Ruler commands and dial buttons changed

[b]ON A DIAL:[/b]
 
 - Click 1/2/3 to spawn appropriate range rings
 - Click Front, Right, Left or Rear to spawn appropriate arc ruler

[b]NEW COMMANDS:[/b]

r1 = spawn range 1 ring
r2 = spawn range 1 ring
r3 = spawn range 1 ring
r = spawn 1-3 range rulers
f = spawn f arc ruler
ff = spawn front 180 arc ruler
sr = spawn right arc ruler
sl = spawn left arc ruler
b = spawn rear arc ruler
fb = spawn full 180 back arc ruler

You can limit/increase the default range 3 check by adding the range to the command. f4 will as an example do an forward arc check out to range 4.

If you add an a to the end of the arc check friendly ships will be included. r2a will as an example check range to all ships within range 2.

25.title: Bomb drop
25.body:
AS OF 1.1.21

You can drop bombs easily using comamnds or "Bomb drop token" spawned with your squad using Squad Builder.

[b]USING THE BOMB TOKEN:[/b]

It will spawn with your ship if it has any bomb upgrades. Will be ready to use and configured with extra drop otpion pilots/upgrades allow.
You can also grab a universal one from near bomb tokens sources.

1. Pick it up and drop near your ship with boms to assign (only once, probably will happen by itself when you move squad from the tray to your side)

2. Click 'Drop bomb" when you want to drop one

3. Click a button representing template which you want to use ('s1' - straight 1 and so on, if it has 'r' on its end it goes out of the front) - a template will spawn

4. Pick up appropriate bomb token and drop it near where it should be - it will snap to correct position

5. Click 'OK' over the template to finish

(6). If you click 'Unassign', you can pick and drop the token again to change dropping ship

Full docs on the token: [i]Wiki page: "Helper tokens"[/i]

[b]USING COMMANDS:[/b]

Command 'b:[code]', where [code] is a move code, will let you drop a bomb using [code] template out of your back. Add 'r' at the end to make it out of the front.

E.g.: 
[i]'b:s1'[/i] will spawn a bomb drop using straight 1 template out of the back.
[i]'b:tr3'[/i] will spawn a bomb drop using turn right 3 template out of the back.
[i]'b:s2r'[/i] will spawn a bomb drop using straight 2 template out of the front.

Full docs on commands: [i]Wiki page: "Doc: Commands"[/i]

27.title: ArcChecks
27.body:
AS OF 1.9.3

[b]Arc Checks:[/b]

Automatic shortest point calculations, and obstruction checks can be performed on any ship in the game.

Right click the ship you want to check arcs from, and choose one of the available ArcCheck options.

All targets in arc will be reported in the chat.

Old arc indicators are removed if you trigger it again for the same ship, or if you check a new arc.

[3030ff]Blue[999999] - Unobstructed shot
[FFFF30]Yellow[999999] - Obstructed shot
[FF30FF]Purple[999999] - Unobstructed bullseye shot
[FF8800]Orange[999999] - Obstructed bullseye shot

28.title: Ship ID
28.body:
All ships, dials and pilot cards now spawn with tintable ship identifiers.

If your ship includes several ships of the same ship type, each of these ships will receive an automatic predefined color value.

If you want to alter the color of a ships identifiers, you simply set the tint color of the corresponding pilot card to a value.

[b]1[/b] Right click pilot card, and select [b]"Color tint"[/b]
[b]2[/b] Select from predefined colors by selecting a coloured square
[b]3[/b] Click apply

If you define your own color, remember to set the alpha value (the gradient bar on the right side) to a visible value. 

If you don't want to remove the identifiers, simply tint the pilot card with the alpha value set to 0.

29.title: AI
29.body:
AS OF 1.10.5a

[b]Artifical Intelligence:[/b]

Some ships can fly themselves using the AI rules from Heroes of the Aturi Cluster.

To enable AI features on a ship, right-click on it and set its description to "ai". This will create two context menu items: "AI move and action", and "AI move".

When selecting a target the ship will treat all ships not assigned to its color as enemies. If none can be found it will say so in the chat and not move.

Once the target it selected it will select a maneuver from its AI table based on range, facing, and stress. It will avoid obstacles (but not ships) if possible.

If you have selected "AI move and action" it will then immediately run through its action list in priority order and execute the first applicable.

[b]Current features:[/b]
- Movement tables for all Imperial ships: TIE Fighter, TIE Interceptor, TIE Advanced x1, TIE Bomber, TIE Defender, TIE Phantom, Lambda Shuttle, Decimator.
- Action tables for the TIE Fighter.
- Handles stress, ion, and target locks.
- Avoid obstacles if possible.

[b]Planned features:[/b]
- Action tables for all Imperial ships
- Board edge avoidance
- AI types (Strike, Defend, Scan, etc)
- Rebel and Scum & Villainy AI
- Formations
- Handling cloak and strain tokens.

[b]Links:[/b]
- Heroes of the Aturi Cluster 0.7 rules (for X-Wing v2): https://heroesoftheaturicluster.godaddysites.com/
- Flight Group Alpha (updated AI for X-Wing 2.0): https://boardgamegeek.com/filepage/229173/flight-group-alpha-an-imperial-co-operative-campai
